capture.requestVerification: This isn't the right animal — Request verification

rejected.hint: Think the AI got it wrong? Send your capture to a moderator.

dead.title: Not on the menu 🦀
dead.message: Faunex records LIVING animals encountered in the field. A dead animal, served on a plate, on a stall or as a trophy doesn't count as an observation. Try again with a living animal!

internet.title: Photo not taken in the field 👀
internet.message: We spotted {{label}}: this image clearly doesn't come from your device. Faunex is about your own observations, not other people's photos. Take a photo of the animal yourself!

representation.title: Nice try 😏
representation.message: This isn't a living animal, it's {{label}}. Faunex only accepts real photographs of animals encountered in the field — statues, toys and drawings don't count.

human.title: Humans aren't collectible 🙂
human.message: Faunex records wild and domestic wildlife: people (and selfies) aren't part of the game. Aim for an animal and try again!

imageTypes.photo_ecran_ou_papier: a photo of a screen or printed image
imageTypes.objet_representation: an object representing an animal (statue, decoration, souvenir…)
imageTypes.animal_mort_ou_plat: a dead or prepared animal (dish, stall, trophy…)

manual.whyModeration: Why is this photo going to moderation?
manual.descDisputed: Tell us what animal you observed. A moderator will confirm or correct the identification before it's added to your Faunex.
manual.descRejected: Explain what you observed: a moderator will review your photo. If the image breaks Faunex's rules, it will be rejected.
manual.descDefault: Describe the animal you observed. Your capture will be reviewed by a moderator before being added to your Faunex.
manual.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the animal: color, size, behaviour, observation location…
